Use P1 as the beneficial owner and signer. The supplied text identifies the income as book royalties and gives your UK tax residence. To complete the treaty claim, you still need the applicable article and paragraph, the withholding rate, and any eligibility conditions.

### Part I — Identification of beneficial owner

```text
[B01] Name of beneficial owner
GIVEN_P1
MIDDLE_P1
SURNAME_P1

[B02] Country of citizenship
India

[B03] Permanent residence address
ADDRESS_P1

[B04] City or town, state or province, postal code
ADDRESS_P1

[B05] Country
ADDRESS_P1

[B06] Mailing address, if different
Street address
NEEDS-YOU
City or town, state or province, postal code
NEEDS-YOU
Country
NEEDS-YOU

[B07] U.S. taxpayer identification number, if required
NEEDS-YOU

[B08] Foreign tax identifying number
NEEDS-YOU

[B09] FTIN not legally required
Leave unchecked.

[B10] Reference number(s), if applicable
NEEDS-YOU

[B11] Date of birth
DATE_P1
```

- **B01** After restoration, combine the three name parts on line 1.
- **B03–B05** After restoration, split the home address by hand. Put the street and unit on B03, the locality and postal code on B04, and the address country on B05. If the stored address omits the country, enter it directly on the form.
- **B06** Leave all three blanks empty if your mailing address is the same. Otherwise, enter the separate mailing address directly on the form.
- **B07** Enter your SSN or ITIN directly on the form if required. Otherwise, leave it blank.
- **B08** Enter your UK National Insurance number directly on the form.
- **B10** Enter the publisher’s reference number if applicable. Otherwise, leave it blank.
- **B11** After restoration, put the date of birth in `MM-DD-YYYY` format by hand.

### Part II — Claim of tax treaty benefits

```text
[B12] Treaty country of residence
United Kingdom

[B13] Article and paragraph
NEEDS-YOU
Withholding rate (%)
NEEDS-YOU
Type of income
Copyright royalties from a book I wrote
Additional eligibility conditions
NEEDS-YOU
```

Confirm that you qualify as a UK resident under the treaty before certifying B12. For B13, enter the treaty provision and rate that apply to your book royalties, and explain any additional conditions that provision requires you to meet.

### Part III — Certification

```text
[B14] Capacity to sign
Check at signing if you can certify that you have capacity to sign.

[B15] Signature
NEEDS-YOU
Date
NEEDS-YOU

[B16] Printed name of signer
GIVEN_P1
MIDDLE_P1
SURNAME_P1
```

Sign B15 yourself and enter the date you sign in `MM-DD-YYYY` format. After restoration, combine the three name parts on B16. Give the completed form to your publisher.
